sloka: मनः च मे दीनम् इह अप्रहृष्टम्चक्षुः च सव्यम् कुरुते विकारम् ।असंशयम् लक्ष्मण न अस्ति सीताहृता मृता वा पथि वर्तते वा ॥३-५७-२३॥
transliteration: manaḥ ca me dīnam iha aprahṛṣṭamcakṣuḥ ca savyam kurute vikāram ।asaṁśayam lakṣmaṇa na asti sītāhṛtā mṛtā vā pathi vartate vā ॥3-57-23॥

translations.english: Appearing in the guise of a deer, this demon allured me to a great distance. With much effort he was somehow killed. but he assumed his demoniac form while dying.
